text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station at noon on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The new prosecutor general Kazys Pednycia was sworn in by President Algirdas Brazauskas today.

- On April 8, a Vilnius court will hear an appeal by the Liberal Union to reverse a decision by the electoral commission, which declared the local election results in Svencionys null and void on the grounds that the Liberals paid for votes.
